Accessibility Statement

Last updated September 30, 2026

Meadow Prints & Embroidery wants everyone to be able to use this website, including people who use screen readers, keyboard navigation, magnification or other assistive technology.

Our goal

We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at Level AA. The site is built with clear headings, descriptive text for product and work photos, visible labels on every form field, and layouts that adapt to phones, tablets and zoomed text.

Known limitations

  • Product photos come from our suppliers and show the blank garment; descriptions give the product name and brand rather than a detailed visual description.
  • Some older pages and photos may not yet meet every guideline. We review and improve the site on an ongoing basis.

Need help or found a problem?

If any part of this site is hard to use, or you need information in a different format, contact us and we'll help you directly, including taking your order by phone or email.

Phone: (732) 763-6078
Email: meadowprintsembroidery@gmail.com

We aim to respond within two business days.
